name: 论文共读
description: Read papers alone or as a chat's reading group: highlights, threads, sourced answers, study cards. Its tools read a paper (a chat's or a project's on this computer), cite a passage as a link back to it, comment, add cards and import arXiv or DOI papers; skill paper-club says how.

zh.name: 论文共读
zh.description: 一个人读，或在群里开读书会：从 arXiv、DOI 导入或上传 PDF，划线、讨论，选一段直接问 agent，它回答里的每个出处点一下就回到原文。一个人用时论文放在本机的项目文件夹里，问本机的任务；在群里时放在群文件夹里，问群里的 agent。学习卡记下每个人的复习和掌握度。

en.name: Paper Club
en.description: Read papers alone or with a chat: import from arXiv or a DOI or upload a PDF, highlight and discuss it, and ask an agent about a passage — every source it cites opens the paper there. Alone, papers stay in a project folder on this computer; cards keep each person's reviews.

author: 咕咕
examples: 总结这篇论文，并在关键段落上划线
给这篇论文出 10 张学习卡片
找出这篇论文的代码并复现主实验
